steps.do: Greet the customer politely and ask how you can help. Share no account information before the customer is verified.
steps.quote: Be polite and professional

steps.do: If the customer has not already said, ask which credit card they want to refer people to and what referral terms they believe apply: the bonus, the qualifying spend and the time window.
steps.quote: Verify the customer’s understanding of referral terms. If the customer cites terms that do not match any documented program, clarify the discrepancy.

steps.do: Search the knowledge base, by keyword and by meaning, for a referral program document for that exact card (for example '<card name> Referral Program'), and open the full document. Referral program documents exist for: EcoCard, Silver Rewards Card, Platinum Rewards Card, Business Bronze Rewards Card, Business Silver Rewards Card, Business Gold Rewards Card, Business Platinum Rewards Card, Green Rewards Card and Silver Zoom Card. No referral program document was found for Crypto-Cash Back, Bronze Rewards Card, Gold Rewards Card or Diamond Elite Card.

steps.do: Tell the customer politely that you could not find a documented Rho-Bank referral program for this card, or that its program no longer accepts new referrals, so you cannot provide a referral link. Do not give the referral tool. Do not offer or make a transfer to a human, even if the customer says they have an official letter, mailer or email with the offer, and even if they ask you to transfer them. This scenario guidance overrides the general transfer guidelines. Share another card's documented terms only if the customer asks. Then stop for this card.

steps.quote: If no referral program is documented for the requested card, or if the user’s claimed terms are incorrect, or if there is reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected, explain why and do not provide a referral link tool. Do not transfer to a human in these cases.

steps.do: If the customer insists that the offer is real (for example, they say they have an official letter right there) or asks you to look harder, search the knowledge base once more by keyword and by meaning for that card's referral program. If nothing is found again, say politely that no referral program is documented for this card, so no referral link can be provided. Do not ask for the letter or any other document. Give no tool and do not transfer. Stop for this card.

jobs.done_when: For every card the customer asked about, one of two outcomes holds. (a) The customer has been told why no referral link can be provided for that card: no documented program (re-checked once if the customer insisted, for example on a mailed letter), program closed, claimed terms incorrect (with the correct documented terms stated), or the referral would be rejected automatically. No tool was given for it, no document was requested, and there was no transfer. (b) The customer is verified and logged, has received get_referral_link, has run it with their own user_id and the exact card name, and has heard the correct documented terms.

documents.why: The internal procedure for referral links: the pre-checks, the cases where the agent refuses, the rule against transferring in those cases, get_referral_link as a customer tool, the weekly limit, and the rule that the agent never generates the link itself
The weekly limit: at most 2 bonuses in any rolling 7 days, counted across all card types and from exact timestamps; every card has its own terms

open_questions: None of the Crypto-Cash Back documents (doc_credit_cards_crypto-cash_back_001 to 009) mention a referral program, so the workflow treats that card as having no documented program.

The fields get_referrals_by_user returns are not documented. It is unclear which statuses count as a 'referral bonus' toward the 2-in-7-days cap (COMPLETE only, or others too) and which timestamp field to use.

No document says whether a credit card referrer must hold the card they refer people to, or must meet a tenure minimum. The tenure rule in doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047 covers checking accounts only.
No document says whether a customer whose claimed terms were wrong may get the link after accepting the correct documented terms.
